systems.system: 112 national emergency number and Emergency Communications Centres
systems.country_label: 112 single national emergency number; Emergency Communications Centres (ECCs)
systems.owner: Nigerian Communications Commission; implementation committee jointly coordinated by the Office of the Vice President and the NCC
systems.tiers: about 35 centres established across the country, per the NCC board chairman; a single number for police, fire, ambulance and other emergency services, adopted by the National Economic Council, rollout still to come

note: The main article is on platform regulation; the police appear only in a trailing teaser on the 112 emergency number, as a response agency whose commitment is needed. Nothing on station records.
